text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon had just finished her Debut 
race. An interview article featuring her 
was published in a magazine, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a natural sprinter, her distance 
aptitude does not match the Triple Crown 
races. It was a critical article pointing 
that out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To convince the public beyond any doubt, 
Mihono Bourbon was determined to prove 
herself with solid results in the upcoming 
Asahi Hai FS.
